svg.title: Batch and stochastic gradient descent on the contours of J
svg.desc: Two copies of the same long, thin elliptical contours of the least-squares cost, both starting from theta equals zero. On the left batch gradient descent drops straight across the contours into the valley in one step and then slides slowly along its floor towards the minimum. On the right stochastic gradient descent takes the same route noisily and keeps jittering near the floor.
